doc.title: Wilson "Chembo" Corniel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019

chapter: Learning the drums and early career
title: Parental support for his drumming
summary: His mother tolerated the drum and loud records at home and never held him back.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Were your parents supportive of your musical path?

Yes, yes. My mother was, my mother was. Because she tolerated me with my drum in the room all kind of hours trying to figure out stuff and playing my record player in my room you know, kind of loud. But I didn’t do it at an inappropriate time or anything like that you know. Mamas, when we were kids, you’ve got to know your limit you know. But I didn’t get any kind of negativity, never got held back by not doing this or don’t do that you know kind of stuff.
